title.description: A short imperative title for the work, at most 60 characters.

criteria.description: Always present. The acceptance criteria: 1 to 7 short statements a reviewer can check against the change, each about behaviour someone can observe. Empty only when the request is too unclear to write any.

priority.description: now: blocks people or breaks something; next: the normal case; later: nice to have.

duplicate_of.description: The ID of an open item (H-0042) that already covers this request entirely, or an empty string.

reason.description: One sentence: the priority's reason, and the duplicate's when there is one.
